property_summary: transfer returns true on success
transfer always reverts when the _tos array is empty
After a successful transfer call, the function returns true for any valid inputs.
The transfer function reverts when the _tos array is empty.
When transfer succeeds (does not revert), the last return value of transfer must be true.
transfer always returns true (i.e., the expression v > 0 is always true when the function does not revert)
transfer returns true iff v > 0
transfer returns true exactly when it returns true
transfer returns a boolean equal to the truth of the statement that the last element of _tos is not zero address
transfer always returns a value equal to the boolean equivalent of the integer v (i.e., v != 0) for non-reverting calls
For any input array _tos, the total balance of the caller (msg.sender) after calling transfer must equal the initial balance minus v times the length of _tos.
transfer should succeed for all valid inputs
The transfer function should always succeed when called with an empty _tos array and should revert when called with a non-empty _tos array.
For any array of recipients, transfer does not revert when called with valid parameters.
For any valid inputs, calling transfer does not cause an out-of-bounds access revert.
After calling transfer with any valid inputs, the total number of successful external calls (via the caddress) must be exactly equal to the length of the _tos array.
All recipients in the array receive the transfer; the number of successful transfers equals the number of recipients.
The sum of transfers executed is exactly ceil(length/2) when skipping every other recipient.
After a call to transfer, the number of transfers executed equals the length of the tos array when counting all attempts, regardless of loop iteration step.
For each call to transfer, the total number of token transfers (as reflected by balance changes) equals the number of recipients in the input array.
After a call to transfer, the number of successful inner calls (captured via a view function that tracks a counter) is exactly the length of the _tos array.
After transfer, the number of successful token transfers equals the number of addresses in the input array.
The transfer function returns true if and only if all internal calls succeed.
The transfer function does not revert when any of the internal calls fail.
The transfer function reverts if any inner call fails.
After calling transfer, the contract's ETH balance changes by the number of tokens transferred only if all internal calls succeed.
